title: Mexican Yellow Bean Tacos
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make recipe for Mexican-style tacos filled with sautéed yellow beans. Perfect for a quick and healthy dinner.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the yellow beans, tacos seasoning, and salt. Stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 5-7 minutes, until the beans are heated through.
Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the tacos by spooning the bean mixture onto a tortilla and topping with chopped cilantro.
